title: Agenda
description: The parts of the talk as a numbered list on hairlines, next to a large heading. The current part is gold and the others step back, so the same slide can return between chapters.

props.items: required, 3-7 parts of the talk, a few words each
props.now: which part is current, counted from 1 (default: none)
props.title: the large heading (default: none)
